referenceEditions.note: Reference layer for translation triangulation. Never outranks the pinned Pāli root; see skill/translation.md 3.2. The only English edition at this commit that covers all five Pāli Nikāyas.

The existing Vietnamese translation, for terminology and phrasing cross-checks. At this commit it covers the Dhammapada only (26 files under kn/dhp); the rest of Thích Minh Châu's canon is not distributed through bilara-data, so absence elsewhere is a property of the upstream snapshot, not a gap in this repository.
